courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘
related.transfer: 可遷移「浮運吃水與壓載」與「止水縫漏流診斷」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Floating draft and ballast" and "Seal leakage diagnosis" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦浮運沉降、球鉸傳力與風暴期間可靠度的共同分析；荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘則以潮汐交換、基礎保護與巨型閘門荷載的共同約束為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on joint analysis of flotation, sinking, spherical-joint loading and storm reliability; Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier centres on coupled constraints on tidal exchange, foundation protection and large gate loads, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「浮運吃水與壓載」與「開口流速與收縮」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「潮位滯後與上浮」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Floating draft and ballast” and “Opening velocity and contraction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Tidal lag and uplift", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「浮運吃水與壓載」與「旋轉門體驅動力矩」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

以「防線接續高程」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Floating draft and ballast” and “Rotating-gate drive torque”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Thames Barrier, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Continuous defence elevations", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘
history.text: 馬仕朗防潮閘在鹿特丹外港航道兩岸配置大型活動門體，與哈特爾防潮閘及堤防共同形成區域防線。馬仕朗防潮閘開始建設，保留主要航道平時開放。 馬仕朗防潮閘建設完成，成為歐洲港防線的一部分。 官方記載馬仕朗防潮閘首次因風暴而關閉防護。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。
history.textEn: The Maeslant Barrier places large movable gates beside the Rotterdam approach waterway and works with the Hartel Barrier and dykes as a regional defence. Construction begins on the Maeslant Barrier while preserving an open main navigation route. The Maeslant Barrier is completed as part of the Europoort defence system. The owner records the first storm-protection closure of the Maeslant Barrier. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
